'''The Matriarch''' is a mob that can be interacted with to access the {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}}, where {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}s can be obtained. It is located in the {{Zone|Matriarch's Lair}}.

== Behavior ==
'''The Matriarch''' generates {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}s, generating {{Green|3}} every {{Green|24h}}. If '''The Matriarch''' has {{Green|1}} or more {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}s available, it will attempt to pull the player towards it and eat them. The player will then be transported to the {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}}.

While in the {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}}, the player's stats are set to their default values and all effects are disabled. The player will be able to collect Heavy Pearls by hitting the piles of them located around the area {{Green|3}} times. Each pile grants {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=1}}, and the player will be able to collect the amount of {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}s that are available. At the same time, stomach acid will rise in the room, dealing heavy damage if the player touches it.

The player can escape the {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}} by punching the tonsils, represented by towers of pigs, hanging from the top of the area. If the player dies to '''The Matriarch''', there will be a {{Green|10}} minute cooldown before they can be eaten again. If all Heavy Pearls have been obtained from '''The Matriarch''', and the cooldown is over, the player can re-enter the {{Zone|Belly of the Beast}}.

{{Item|Matriarch's Perfume}} can be used to make '''The Matriarch''' instantly produce {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=3}}s; it can be used up to {{Green|4}} times per day. Additionally, the {{Attr|Matriarch Cubs}} attribute grants, at its maximum level, a {{Green|+20%}} chance to gain an additional {{Item|Heavy Pearl}} when collecting one, meaning it is possible to get up to {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=6}}s (the average amount being {{Item|Heavy Pearl|amount=3.8}}s).

== Tips ==
*You can find the Heavy Pearls' location while being eaten by '''The Matriarch''', to set up the route for getting the Heavy Pearls. You should try to aim for one of the Heavy Pearls, and grab it as soon as the tentacles release you (similar to {{MobSprite|Storm}} boss fight's prefire). Also, when you find the pigs after getting all the pearls needed, spam hitting them to get up before the acid gets up.
*While wearing Unstable Dragon Armor, when trying to escape using the pigs, it has a chance to strike lightning onto all of the pigs at once and lifting you out of '''The Matriarch''' without even hitting a pig once.
*While using the {{Item|Flaming Fist}}, only one hit is needed to collect a heavy pearl, and only one hit is needed on a tonsil to escape. This may be used as a method to speedrun '''The Matriarch'''.
*Unlike [[Time_Systems#Hypixel_Server_Time|many other systems in the game which reset daily at 12AM ET]], the cooldown for '''The Matriarch''' instead resets daily at 8PM ET.

== Trivia ==
* [[The Matriarch]] contains a [[fandom:starwars:Boba Fett|Boba Fett]] helmet within the digestive fluid on the floor, likely referencing his fall into the [[fandom:starwars:Great Pit of Carkoon|Great Pit of Carkoon]] in ''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi''.
* Collecting all {{Green|3}} {{Item|Heavy Pearl}}s in the Matriarch without taking damage rewards the {{AchievementLink|The Perfect Heist}} achievement.
* The word Matriarch usually refers to a woman in charge of a family, a group or a state. <ref> https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/matriarch
</ref>
